title: Replace one current-Principal Project pin order without last-write-wins ambiguity

requirements.invariant: Personal Project pins may select and order which canonical category-progress values are presented, but replacing a preference can never supply or change category definitions, contributions, spend, allocations, paid/unpaid state or canonical budget arithmetic.

UpdateProjectPreferences is one idempotent own-Principal operation over an immutable AccountID and ProjectID plus a complete ordered duplicate-free pin replacement. It carries no user-selected backend path, category label, lifecycle state, financial value or mutation of shared reference data.

The command records the exact business intent to replace personal Project pins through typed Ledger values and exposes no arbitrary field map, collection path, SQL string, generic CRUD, category-definition write, first-use default, visibility repair or budget calculation.

The pin replacement is bound to exactly one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID and finite client-created time through the shared operation fingerprint and receipt lifecycle; this slice defines no competing queue, retry, result or rejection semantics.

The command distinguishes an authoritatively absent preference from a stored preference at one exact expected revision. The corresponding same-subject expected-state or expected-revision precondition prevents a stale offline replacement from silently becoming last-write-wins and preserves stored-empty versus absent truth.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral ProjectPreferenceUpdating port accepts only the typed command and returns the shared OperationReceipt. The envelope actor identifies the intended preference owner, but a later trusted session and handler must derive and enforce the authenticated Principal rather than trusting a caller-supplied user path.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no preference row/table, authorization policy, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ProjectPreferenceExpectedState is exactly notStored or revision(UInt64); it maps to one same-subject expected-state or expected-revision precondition and never treats stored empty pins as absence.

ProjectPreferenceUpdateDraft binds one Account, actor Principal, contract version, stable Project, complete ordered duplicate-free pin list, expected state and finite capture time. Archived or unresolved stable IDs may remain intent evidence; no category label/lifecycle/amount or other Principal is carried.

UpdateProjectPreferencesPayload contains only ProjectID and ordered pin IDs. UpdateProjectPreferencesCommand derives the current-Principal preference subject and shared fingerprint, validates every draft/envelope/payload/precondition/subject binding on construction and decode, and validates only matching OperationID receipts.

ProjectPreferenceUpdating exposes only updateProjectPreferences(_:) and returns the shared OperationReceipt. ProjectPreferenceUpdateFailure provides stable bounded time, scope, pin, expected-state, payload, subject, fingerprint, receipt, local-acceptance and encoding failures.

items: The complete command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, exact reference-data subject and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Not-stored and exact-revision intent remain distinct across restart, including stored-empty pin replacement. Changed Account, actor, contract, Project, pin/order, expected state, subject, preconditions, fingerprint or receipt fails atomically.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/mismatch/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, optimistic UI or authoritative server-apply evidence.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot authorize a Principal, persist/display/apply a preference, resolve category validity or visibility, calculate budgets, mutate shared reference data, define schema/RLS/Sync/provider/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.

O-026 remains open for shared reference-data administration; A-003/A-004/A-007/A-016, physical offline verification, canonical production preference profiling and all hosted-resource authority remain outside this command boundary.

verification.expected: Valid absent and revisioned synthetic drafts create exact own-Principal complete pin-replacement commands with ordered unique stable IDs, matching same-subject preconditions and no category definition, label, lifecycle, budget value, user path or provider field.

Not-stored, revisioned, reordered and stored-empty replacement commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Project/pins/expected-state/time/subject/fingerprint evidence.

Duplicate pins, invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/Project/pin order/expected state/payload/subject/preconditions/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, the same OperationID with changed Project/pins/expected state is refused by the shared lifecycle, and a failing port returns no false receipt.
